results.title: If things could ever talk
results.overview: On a winter morning in Catania, Rachele return to the apartment she once shared with Paolo to gather her belongings. As she packs, ordinary objects bring back traces of their recently ended relationship. Their emotional value recalls the tradizion of the bridal trousseau, opening a reflection across generations on the meaning we give to objects, home, and relationships today.

results.title: This Is Our City
results.overview: The ambitious son of a ruthless mob boss hires a film crew, who end up being undercover FBI agents, to document his life as a dysfunctional and delusional gangster.

results.title: Theo
results.overview: Theo is determined to be allowed to play football, no matter the boundaries.

results.title: Folding Sadness
results.overview: Tita tries to forget her ex, who is about to get married, by spending her days in the kitchen. In the end, Tita decides to attend the wedding to resolve everything.

results.title: The Power of Pickleball
results.overview: "The Power of Pickleball" tells the story of a humble game that spread into a cultural phenomenon by bringing people together across generations, backgrounds, and walks of life. Centered on the passionate individuals who helped build the sport from the ground up, the film celebrates pickleball's unique ability to create community, spark joy, and change lives in unexpected ways.

results.title: monument
results.overview: This singular 6-part essay film on the history of the state of Rhode Island illustrates the adage that the universal is best reached via the particular: the very local issues investigated in the film blossom into a body of insights and speculations extending far beyond the borders of any region.  'monument' weaves statues, plaques and place names together with the routine movements of everyday life. Readings from history books, monologues from a fictional tour guide, and personal home movies are paired with interviews relating to the Colonial Era, the Slave Trade, the American Revolution, the Industrial Revolution, Indigenous Cultures, the Abolitionist Movement, Organized Crime, Urban Planning, Capitalism, Baseball, Ancient Geology, and Apple Pie. Over time stories overlap and voices converge to create a dynamic, multi-layered temporal x-ray, challenging the objectification of history with the animism of storytelling.

results.title: La rabia
results.overview: First film directed by Daniela López Moreno. World Premiere at 30th Fantasia Film Festival.

results.title: Heartshell
results.overview: In this surrealist 2D animated film, a wounded heart encases itself in a protective shell and retreats into the depths of its own reflections, confronting themes of vulnerability, self-protection, and the difficult challenge of opening up.

results.title: Oh How Embarrassing To Be Human
results.original_title: Oh How Embarrassing To Be Human
results.overview: The rip-roaring tale of mankind's stupid, selfish and oblivious journey through time, history, and space.

results.title: Behind the True Story of Sometimes I Imagine Your Funeral
results.original_title: Behind the True Story of Sometimes I Imagine Your Funeral
results.overview: Behind the True Story takes you behind the scenes of Vince Dixon's 'Sometimes I Imagine Your Funeral', a short film based on Vince and his real-life experience of losing his sister Lauren to an overdose. Crowdfunded by his community and the addiction recovery networks, Vince was able to bring together a team of Los Angeles-based and Indianapolis-based creatives to film in his home community of central Indiana. The short film follows Max as he processes how to eulogize his sister Chloe, an experience that mirrors Vince’s own. This documentary is a behind-the-scenes look at the multi-day filmmaking process of the film and is a tribute to the real-life friends and family who helped Vince create this awareness film

results.title: Beware the Box Folk
results.overview: While pursuing a deadly political scandal in the midst of a garbage strike, a muckraking journalist uncovers a strange community of people who have escaped society by wearing cardboard boxes and hiding amongst the trash.

results.title: AGAIN
results.overview: After having her proverbial third eye opened by the strange man who calls himself The Great Opticisioner, Evie Narmer is able to see directly into her past lives. Proving two things: reincarnation is real, but also that her past lives were awful. One of them in particular depicts an awful cult that she thus writes a deep and detailed novel on. Unexpectedly, the last surviving original member catches wind of this novel, and reignites the flame that cult once had. Now, that old man and Evie are at odds. What will happen next? Watch and find out.

results.title: The March to War: Iran, Israel and the USA
results.original_title: The March to War: Iran, Israel and the USA
results.overview: As the first American and Israeli missiles hit Iran on February 28, 2026, U.S. government officials argued that this was not the start of war. Instead, it was just the next stage in a conflict that started with the 1979 Islamic Revolution that toppled the American and Israeli-backed regime of the Shah, and made the U.S. and Israel sworn enemies of the new Islamic state.  THE MARCH TO WAR is a unique three-part series that looks at the deep roots of the “infinite roller-coaster” of conflict that has ensnared Israel and Iran and drawn in the United States. Was open war inevitable, the series asks? And could the escalation have been stopped?  The series tells the story through the voices of those that shaped it: politicians (including former U.S. Secretary of Defense Leon Panetta and Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu), military commanders, intelligence chiefs and ambassadors, from all sides, along with political scientists and historians.

results.title: Terra Bruta
results.overview: In 19th-century southern Brazil, Miguel returns to the land where his story was shattered. As he confronts memories and looming threats, he advances on a journey of purification across rugged terrain and amidst ancient ghosts.

results.title: Transience
results.overview: Two homeless companions discover a magical hourglass with the power to rewind time… but only for ten seconds. They soon realise that this could be an opportunity to drastically change their situation. However, their plan requires two people, and neither one fully trusts the other.

results.title: No Supers
results.overview: In a world that hates "Supers," Jabari finds his back against the ropes in an illegal underground boxing match when he discovers that he has more strength than he knows how to handle.

results.title: Backstage
results.overview: Theater actor Lukas becomes entangled in a toxic relationship with his influential director Cosima. What begins as a harmless flirtation between the two increasingly develops into a perfidious game of seduction, power, and manipulation. When Philippe, a charismatic actor from Cosima's past, appears, the situation begins to escalate.

results.title: Behind Me
results.overview: YOU CANNOT OUTRUN A SHADOW THAT WEARS YOUR OWN FACE  Haunted by a silent manifestation of her own moral decay, a young woman is pushed to the edge of sanity by a doppelgänger that anticipates her every move.
